svg.text: tb_units: transfer of one DDA unit as used in the MP-DDA, tt 27 C
fA = i(Vfx1) - i(Vfy1) for unit A (gp = vref + x), fB = i(Vfx2) - i(Vfy2) for unit B (gn = vref - x); replace unit_r2 by unit_r, unit_t, unit_w or unit_q to test another unit
meas dc fa05 find fA at=0.5
meas dc fb05 find fB at=0.5
meas dc fam05 find fA at=-0.5
meas dc fbm05 find fB at=-0.5
